iti81:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti81:2.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
iti81:3.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā asakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
iti81:4.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena ca asakkārena ca tadubhayena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
iti81:5.1: taṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave nāññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā sutvā vadāmi.
iti81:5.2: api ca bhikkhave yadeva me sāmaṃ ñātaṃ sāmaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sāmaṃ viditaṃ tadevāhaṃ vadāmi:
iti81:6.1: ‘diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
iti81:7.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā asakkārena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
iti81:8.1: diṭṭhā mayā bhikkhave sattā sakkārena ca asakkārena ca tadubhayena abhibhūtā pariyādinnacittā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā’ti.
iti81:11.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
